notes:
Account background: Verdance builds a midsize product analytics & customer success platform; 450 employees; heavy multi-tenant SaaS. They want to add conversational support agents to reduce tier 1 load by ~30% and accelerate SLA responses.

Recent conversation summary (shorthand):
- 2026-02-14 demo with AE/SE: showed streaming + tool-calling prototype (ticket search + triage). Customer: 'Streaming is non-negotiable — must feel instant to users.'
- POC scope agreed: 2-week Hosted API POC using live anonymized tickets (10k queries), measure first-token latency, end-to-end tool-calling latency, and fallbacks.
- Latency target: strict <1.5s first-token SLO at 95th percentile under a 150-200 TPS burst model. Must support streaming chunked responses and incremental tool calls (search, KB recall).
- Data residency: production logs in US only; audit logs required for compliance. KMS for encryption keys.
- Model preferences: open-model baseline (quantized Llama family) for cost tests, and one larger Redwood-verified variant for quality. Will evaluate conversation quality / hallucination rates.
- Business concerns: pricing sensitivity — wants unit cost estimate for 100M tokens/month projection; comparing to building on self-hosted stack (GKE + GPUs) vs Redwood Hosted/Dedicated.

POC milestones & accept criteria (short):
- Week 1: integration + streaming demo, Sanity quality checks, security review kickoff.
- Week 2: Load run (10k requests), latency profiling, tool-calling reliability tests, final report. Accept if 95th pctl first-token <1.5s and success rate of tool-calls >99%.

Quotes & callouts:
- SE: 'We need to see KV-cache behavior with our long histories (avg 12 msg conv).'
- Product lead: 'If streaming and tool-calls are flaky it's a non-starter.'
- Finance: 'Committed pricing or reserved capacity will be helpful to meet ARR model.'

Security/compliance notes:
- IT asked for SOC2/ISO27001 proof, intake doc linked. Will need SSO and tenant-level audit logs. Retention controls for transcripts (30-90 days).

Risks:
- If Hosted metrics don't hit SLOs, they'll push to Dedicated or hybrid with region pinning.
- Procurement timeline could slip if legal asks for data processing addendum updates.

Action items (AE/SE):
- AE (Alyssa): schedule pricing session with finance 2026-03-10.
- SE (Marcus): deliver test harness & sample script for streaming latency testing by 2026-02-24.
- Security: send SOC2 package + SSP link; request SSO metadata from Verdance IT.

requirements_summary: Mid-market SaaS with chat-agent primary. Requires streaming responses, tool calling (KB search, ticket lookup), sub-1.5s first-token SLO at 95th pct under expected burst. Data residency US, SSO, audit logs, retention controls. Want Hosted API first; potential move to Dedicated if capacity/SLOs need predictable throughput.
technical_notes: Key technical asks: support for streaming chunked RTTs, function/tool call handoffs, KV cache for long context, quantized model profiles for cost testing, telemetry hooks (per-request latency, per-token cost), and rollout policy for canary fallback to smaller models.
sales_playbook_notes: Mid-market play: start with low-friction Hosted API trial, provide latency benchmarks and test harness, propose 3-tier pricing: POC rates -> monthly committed -> reserved Dedicated. Emphasize Redwood Optimize recommendations to reduce unit cost after POC.
